DECISION: Abandoned programmatic fillRect pixel art (ugly, nothing like real pixel art). Cloned https://github.com/nicholasgasior/pixel-agents (MIT license) for real sprite sheets.

WHAT WAS COPIED: Character sprites, floor tiles, wall tiles, furniture PNGs — all into /public/assets/.

RENDERER REWRITE: src/game/renderer.ts and src/game/sprites.ts rewritten to load Image objects from /assets/ paths and drawImage onto canvas with imageSmoothingEnabled=false.

GOTCHA: If Image objects aren't loaded before first render tick, renderer falls back to fillRect placeholders — canvas may look broken on initial load.

PIXEL AGENTS LAYOUT: Uses 16px tiles, characters are ~16x32 chibi style, colorized via canvas compositing (hue-rotate or tint overlay per palette).
